items.prompt:
Repaint input 1 into one square finished hand-painted anime priestess game card, 满月形态. Input 1 locks the NEW composition: a priestess standing at image-right in three-quarter view toward left, face in upper-right, one raised open hand above a full moon disk at left, the other hand palm-up below it, connected torso and waist, long braid along the right quiet side, white dress through bottom crop. Also preserve input 1's COLORED DARK BACKGROUND: very dark desaturated indigo/teal at top transitioning into gray-violet below, quiet and abstract, never white. Input 2 (current fullmoon card) and input 3 (wind song card) lock LIGHT PRIESTESS XINGYUE IDENTITY and broad opaque paint style only; do not copy either old pose or backdrop.

Two essential corrections:
1. Reduce the giant gray sphere to a flat luminous COMPLETE CIRCULAR MOON DISK about ONE THIRD of the square width, occupying the left-center gap between her palms, not half the canvas and not covering her chest. Adjust palms subtly to hover close to its upper and lower edges with natural hand proportions and connected arms. Moon is a cool pale ivory plane with one faint broad gray value turn and a restrained luminous edge; no rendered round ball, crater landscape, inscriptions, big halo or particles. Head, hands and moon have clear breathing space.
2. Replace the draft's green eyes, side-part cold-white hair and missing cape with reference-accurate Xingyue: very pale low-saturation golden/ivory hair following references' actual warm pale locks and muted gray shadows, dense straight fringe, smooth rounded crown, two long cheek sidelocks, one thick low side braid. WARM GOLD EYES, calm relaxed brows, closed neutral mouth, no blush or smile. White crescent hair ornament flat just above bangs at viewer-right. White high-collared priestess dress, a small four-point star clasp and restrained gold collar trim, DEEP FOREST-TEAL SHORT CAPE with sparse gold edging, dark wrist guards leaving fingers exposed. Keep the current new three-quarter head direction; do not turn the face frontal. Cape is one broad dark plane sweeping quietly behind her shoulder.

STYLE: rough hand-painted anime illustration built from large connected opaque matte color masses, a few wide directional curved or elongated swipes and blunt dabs. Decisive handmade edges, clear grouped light/shadow, selective overlaps and broken stroke endings surrounded by calm interiors. Moonlight softly illuminates cheek, fingers and sleeves, with one broad warm/cool transition rather than glossy gradients.
Hair follows the broad-plane painting of the supplied references: substantial contiguous locks, quiet pale base areas, one or two broad cool-gray shadow turns and sparse opaque highlight swaths. Braid sections large interlocking masses. No dense strands, chipped micro highlights, tiny facets or glossy sculpted ribbons.
Face and golden eyes selectively clear, economical nose/mouth, fringe cast shadow, nose underside and under-jaw/neck planes, a few purposeful tapered colored accents. Hands anatomically natural and readable. White sleeves/dress and teal cape use principal broad fold planes following shoulder, elbows, torso and waist with sparse structural creases and quiet cloth regions. Background simpler, blended colored masses with only a few broad subtle painterly passes; preserve indigo-to-gray-violet gradient. No landscapes, stars, curtains, architecture, ornaments, grain/canvas filters, photoreal materials, glossy 3D, airbrush, fine wrinkle networks, uniform traced outlines, text, watermark, frame or UI.

feedback: 老板指出NAI提示词有问题，下次减少长句堆叠，优先明确尺寸主次、关键外貌、背景；本轮NAI月轮过大、角色绿眼冷白发，内置重绘已定向修正。
